# GitHub Repo Landing Page Skill

English | [繁體中文](README.zh-TW.md)

An agent skill (standard `SKILL.md` format, usable by any AI coding agent that supports skills, such as Claude Code or Grok CLI) that turns any GitHub repository URL or `README.md` into a production-grade, bilingual (Traditional Chinese / English), single-file HTML landing page.

![Demo: a landing page generated by Grok CLI with this skill for JetBrains/thinkrail](assets/demo.gif)

*The landing page above was generated by Grok CLI with this skill for [JetBrains/thinkrail](https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail) (Apache-2.0). The GIF shows the hero, a scroll through a few sections, and the 繁體中文 / English switch.*

**Live demo:** [https://malilion.github.io/github-repo-landing-page-skill/demo/](https://malilion.github.io/github-repo-landing-page-skill/demo/)

**Second live demo:** [https://malilion.github.io/github-repo-landing-page-skill/demo/macro/](https://malilion.github.io/github-repo-landing-page-skill/demo/macro/), generated by Grok CLI with this skill for [macro-inc/macro](https://github.com/macro-inc/macro) (AGPL-3.0).

**Another live demo:** [https://malilion.github.io/github-repo-landing-page-skill/demo/assistant-ui/](https://malilion.github.io/github-repo-landing-page-skill/demo/assistant-ui/), generated by Grok CLI with this skill for [assistant-ui/assistant-ui](https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui) (MIT).

## Features

- **Single file**: everything lives in one `index.html`; no build step, no npm install.
- **CDN only**: Tailwind CSS, Google Fonts (incl. Noto TC) and Lucide Icons, with pinned versions and SRI where supported.
- **Adaptive design**: picks a visual direction that matches the repo (CLI/DevOps, AI/SaaS, design tools, consumer/gaming).
- **Instant bilingual switch**: 繁體中文 / English via a client-side `data-i18n` dictionary, no reload.
- **No broken assets, no invented facts**: uses the repo's real screenshots when they exist, otherwise Tailwind mockups and SVGs; content comes only from the repo (local files first).
- **Complete sections**: SEO/Open Graph meta, sticky header, hero, visual showcase, feature grid, multi-platform install tabs with copy button, FAQ accordion, footer.

## Usage

1. Put this repo (or just `SKILL.md`) in your agent's skill folder, e.g. `.claude/skills/github-repo-landing-page/SKILL.md` or `.grok/skills/github-repo-landing-page/SKILL.md`, so the tool can discover it.
2. Give the agent a local clone, a GitHub repo URL, or paste its README, for example `https://github.com/owner/repo`.
3. It writes `landing/index.html` (never overwrites an existing `index.html`) and runs the verification checklist. Open it in a browser or host it on GitHub Pages.

### Headless runs

Recommended Grok CLI setup (no shell tool, writes limited to `landing/`):

```bash
grok --prompt-file prompt.md --cwd <repo> --trust --permission-mode dontAsk \
  --tools read_file,list_dir,grep,write,search_replace,todo_write \
  --allow 'Write(<repo>/landing/**)' --allow 'Edit(<repo>/landing/**)' \
  --deny 'Read(~/.grok/**)' --deny 'Write(~/**)' --deny 'Edit(~/**)' \
  --disable-web-search --max-turns 30
```

- In `dontAsk` mode any tool call that is not pre-approved cancels the whole turn (`stopReason: cancelled`). Restricting `--tools` to file tools and allowing writes only under `<repo>/landing/**` lets the run finish.
- `--permission-mode acceptEdits` does not allow shell commands (it only auto-approves file edits), so it does not solve this.
- A shell allowlist did not work in testing: compound commands (`&&`, `;`, `||`, redirects) are checked per segment, and two runs were cancelled within seconds.
- Headless runs need `--trust` for project skills in `.grok/skills/` to be discovered. It is a hidden flag and writes `~/.grok/trusted_folders.toml`; remove that entry afterwards if you do not want the folder to stay trusted.
- Without a shell the agent cannot run a browser check itself; verify the page afterwards (e.g. with Playwright).

## Tested with Grok CLI

One run on 2026-10-29 with Grok CLI 1.0.62 against [JetBrains/thinkrail](https://github.com/JetBrains/thinkrail) (a GitHub Trending repo, Apache-2.0), using the headless setup above:

| Result | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Stop reason | `end_turn` |
| Duration | about 29 minutes |
| Turns | 18 |
| Cost | about US$0.58 |

These are the numbers of a single run; they vary with the model and the repository.

Checked afterwards with Playwright:

- The page uses the repo's real screenshots; no fabricated badges.
- No console errors.
- No horizontal overflow at 390px width.
- The 繁體中文 / English switch works.

| --- | --- |
